title: a2a impl-lane result
description: The result an impl-lane worker writes. This IS devloop's `sample-task-result.json` shape, so a devloop-dispatched worker's result is parsed by devloop step 4.3.4 without an adapter. a2a itself enforces only the top-level `required` list (src/reconcile.rs::schema_gate); the rest of this document is the published contract and the `--output-schema` payload handed to codex.

status.description: `pass` only when every acceptance criterion was verified; `stuck` when the same failure repeated and the work needs a human.

iterations.description: How many implement/verify cycles this task took.

summary.description: What was done and what was verified, in prose, with the evidence that backs each claim.

evidence.description: Verification evidence. The sub-keys are toolkit-dependent — the four below are devloop's playwright set and are documented, not required; an `api` or `cli` task carries whatever its own toolkit produces.

files_changed.description: Every file this task created or modified, repo-relative.

next_step_hint.description: One sentence for whoever picks the work up next, or null when there is nothing to hand over.
